activity.role: King Edward VIII of the United Kingdom, abdicated December 1936
activity.notes: Edward VIII succeeded January 20, 1936; signed the Instrument of Abdication December 10, given legal effect December 11. The 1936–1936 rail is an exact SAME-YEAR reign with separately documented days, NOT an implied full year. Other distinct offices including Governor of the Bahamas 1940–1945 require separate Activity; he also held royal titles across self-governing dominions and Emperor of India. Avoid inventing one world empire polity or treating royal title as unlimited effective direct rule.
